final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS pt, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS alb_tp FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), o AS (SELECT AVG(pt) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.SEX, AVG(g.pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(g.alb_tp) AS avg_alb_tp, AVG(g.pt - o.overall) AS avg_pt_diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.SEX
